verdict.rationale: Airwallex ships its own agent tooling: the CLI exposes a broad slice of the API as read/write commands, and the hosted AgentOS MCP lets agents write production resources, including a contract-to-billing skill. Payment Links and multi-product billing exist as product features. However, no evidence shows API endpoints for creating products, prices, or payment links, or that an agent can chain all three in one session. Missing for 10: documented Products/Prices API creation endpoints, a documented payment-link creation API, an end-to-end agent workflow covering product→price→link, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent provision a new product, price, and payment link via the API in a single session

citations.quote: Payment Links are the easiest way for you to accept payments online without a digital storefront.
Multi-item: Billing for multiple products in one place
